summary: o-fe1abcbfcbc56d57: The old harness satisfies the parser-produced array depth requirement before and after g0001. Parsing rejects container nesting at the same threshold used by the new array printer.

claims.necessity_reason: The harness prints only trees returned by cJSON_ParseWithOpts. Array and object parsing both enforce CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT before adding a container, and both print paths start at depth zero. No accepted parser-produced array reaches the new depth rejection.

before.requirement: Print a parser-produced array without rejecting a nesting depth accepted by parsing.
before.reason: The old array printer has no depth rejection, and the harness passes its parsed tree to a print function.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Parser dispatch sends arrays and objects to their respective parsers.
Array parsing rejects nesting at the limit.
Object parsing applies the same limit to mixed nesting.

after.requirement: Print a parser-produced array without rejecting a nesting depth accepted by parsing.
after.reason: The new array print check uses the same threshold as both container parsers. Parsing and printing start at depth zero and increase depth for each container.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Parser dispatch sends arrays and objects only to their respective parsers.
Array parsing rejects nesting at the printer's threshold.
Object parsing applies the same threshold to mixed nesting.
The parser initializes depth to zero before dispatch.
Unbuffered printing zeroes its print buffer before dispatch.
Buffered printing also initializes depth to zero.

claims.comparison_reason: Both versions satisfy the same requirement for arrays obtained through the old harness's parse call. The new rejection cannot apply to a parser-accepted container depth.
